prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first art-direction concept board for an original third-person multiplayer fantasy life/social game. This is a concept illustration, not an actual gameplay screenshot.
Create ONE cohesive, beautiful landscape concept board, approximately 3:2 aspect ratio. The upper approximately 68 percent is a large, richly composed town environment illustration; the bottom approximately 32 percent is a spacious full-body character lineup on a muted warm stone-gray neutral background. Use a subtle clean separation. Absolutely no text, lettering, logos, UI, watermarks, titles, borders with labels, or fake developer annotations.

ART INTENT: A place an adult player would want to inhabit: broad fresh air, grounded rustic community, people doing ordinary things together, a little distant mystery. Warm and inviting but rugged and spacious rather than sugary, toy-like, childish or luxurious. Fantasy is expressed through terrain, silhouettes and a few intriguing distant features, with restrained magical effects. Original world and costumes.

ENVIRONMENT, upper panel:
A small highland settlement built beside a natural freshwater lake on an elevated grassy plateau. Beyond the plateau, distant layered blue mountains, immense cliffs and soft clouds give a convincing sense of height and a much larger unexplored world. Ground-level elevated third-person-adventure camera perspective, near normal human eye level, wide but not fisheye; the town is inhabitable and human-scaled, not an aerial city vista.
The lake and its broad accessible shore are the social center. A curving well-trodden cobbled path connects fishing piers, a small open gathering square with a communal fire, a welcoming inn and a practical repair workshop. About six substantial small buildings, thick timber frames, rounded rough-stone foundations, broad sloping grass-and-slate roofs, canvas shades, hand-carved structural beams, warm window recesses. Architectural language: sturdy rounded masses and visible handmade construction. No tall European fairy-tale castles or huge ornamental towers. Include a modest original stone-and-timber beacon at the far end of the lake, a landmark rather than the main subject.
Foreground: a readable adult player traveler seen from a rear three-quarter view, sturdy boots and a practical red scarf, approaching the waterside gathering. Midground: roughly eight adult residents/players, spaced in plausible pairs and small groups: two fishing beside each other, two speaking by a workbench, a seated person by a fire, a person carrying a basket. Human bodies remain small enough that the environment dominates, but clearly identifiable. Not a massive crowd, not deserted, no combat, no raised weapons, no armor display.
Soft late-afternoon side sunlight, fresh green grasses, ochre timber, muted turquoise lake water, warm light on sandstone, distant cool-blue atmospheric layers. One or two subtle unfamiliar plants and a faint curious light near the distant lakeshore hint at magic. Good directional light and strong readable shapes, not excessive bloom or sparkles.
Rich polished painterly 3D game concept style, hand-painted texture sensibility, stylized thick natural forms, convincing scale and material separation. Medium detail density with broad calm surfaces. Avoid photorealism, ultra-detailed gritty realism, heavy outlines, voxel art and plastic low-poly toy appearance.

CHARACTERS, bottom panel:
Four separate head-to-toe original adult human character designs arranged side by side, comfortable space around each, all in the SAME world, rendering style, palette and approximately 6.5-head stylized adult proportions. Clear silhouettes, expressive but grounded faces, large readable hands and sturdy shoes, practical layered linen/wool/leather clothing with visible wear and repairs. A coherent shared production-friendly humanoid design language, not radically different species.
1. Player traveler: an adult man about 28, short dark hair, moss-green short travel coat, restrained rust-red scarf, brown boots, belt pouch and simple small backpack, relaxed confident posture, everyday adventuring clothing with no armor or sword. Match the traveler in the upper scene.
2. Older fisherman: a sturdy gray-bearded man with weathered friendly face, canvas vest and rolled sleeves, practical hat, fishing rod and small creel, warm earth colors.
3. Innkeeper: a middle-aged woman with tied-back dark hair, welcoming confident expression, muted teal everyday dress with worn apron and berry-colored shawl, holding a simple wooden mug.
4. Repair craftsperson: an adult woman with short brown hair, strong forearms, ochre shirt, leather work apron and tool belt, small hammer held naturally at her side.
Readable faces and clothing at concept-board viewing distance. Keep all four figures complete, no cropped feet or heads, no extra limbs, no duplicated tools.
The result must make town and people feel like one coherent art direction. Do not reproduce any existing game's characters, iconic racial designs, emblems, architecture or named locations. No recognizable Warcraft/Tauren/Orc elements, totem poles, huge shoulder armor, or copied buildings.

visible_strengths: Highland lake, substantial timber-and-stone buildings and a third-person traveler establish one coherent setting.
Fishing, gathering around a fire and workshop activity are visible.
Four full-body adult character designs share the environment palette and practical clothing.
limitations: Concept illustration only; models, animation, lighting and multiplayer are not implemented.
Layout gives the character lineup more space than the requested approximate proportions.
Magic is subtle and the design currently reads as rustic fantasy.
